header: WHAT THE SERVER READS FOR THE KOLKATA TAB: the saved trains and fares of the third set (kolkataStore.ts), DATABASE ONLY. I never ask RailRadar here: the paid month collected everything (scripts/harvest-kol.ts) and after it the database is all there is, as for the other two tabs. The catalogue and the fare summaries are kept ten minutes in this copy's memory (they change only when I run the harvest), so that opening a station, a fare box and the fare finder do not each read six hundred trains again. A database failure is thrown (the route turns it into a plain 503): the tab says it cannot show the trains, it never shows a half-read list.
